# aitherkvcache

> Near-optimal KV cache quantization for LLM inference — sub-byte compression.

KV cache, not weights, is what runs a GPU out of room during real serving, and it grows with every token of every concurrent request.

## Install

```
pip install aither-kvcache
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Quantize the cache on one model you already serve and measure the headroom.

## Composes with

- [awnode](https://aitherium.github.io/awnode/) — A lightweight local gateway — bridges your apps to the AI backends you chose.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/aitherkvcache
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/aitherkvcache/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/aitherkvcache/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-kvcache.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
